mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days across all monetary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 1.5% signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS occurs in more than 50% of cases but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes characterized by high housing starts (HOUST) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1), overvaluation and economic slowdown expectations drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST > 1200 and GDPC1 > 17000), SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO falls below 104.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising RSAFS and rising HOUST occurs in more than 50% of cases but SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of those cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports economic growth and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in all regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 1250.0 thousand units signal a strong housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate revenues, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1250.0.
